title: Eurostat SDG 11.52: Premature deaths due to exposure to PM2.5, Italy (annual, JSON-stat API)
summary: National annual series for Italy only: premature deaths attributed to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), published by Eurostat under SDG indicator 11.52. The series is returned by the Eurostat dissemination JSON-stat API, with dimensions freq, airpol, effect, unit (number and rate), geo and time. The API response covers 18 annual time points from 2005 to 2023 with 36 cells, and 2006 is absent from the time dimension. It is national context only, with no district, station or hourly grain.

documentation_excerpts: Premature deaths due to exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) (JSON-stat label, inspect_dataset_link)
sample_findings: Full JSON-stat response (5,827 bytes) was read via summarize_jsonstat, not a row sample. Time dimension: 18 values, 2005 and 2007 to 2023; 2006 is not present. expected_cells 36, value_count 36, missing_cells 0 (tool-computed, not a source flag).
Unit dimension has two values: NR (Number) and RT (Rate). Rate unit is not stated.
Single values for freq (A), airpol (PM2_5), effect (PMD), geo (IT). No negative or sentinel values were inspected because the values were not profiled row by row.
quality_notes: Time gap: the year 2006 is missing from the returned time dimension (summarize_jsonstat and inspect_dataset_link both list 2005, 2007 to 2023). Annual coverage is not continuous.
Data ends in 2023 (time.last = 2023). It does not cover the production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 and cannot support the live model in that window.
Only Italy (geo = IT) and only annual; no hourly, daily or district grain, so it fits N6 only (national annual context).
The rate unit (RT) is not defined in the API summary; numbers and rates must not be mixed without checking the source metadata.
Eurostat label 'updated' is 2025-12-09, but the refresh cadence is not stated in any fetched source.
Catalog candidate states it targets the prototype window only; the series' 2005 start falls inside the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) only for the single year 2005.

Dimensions are freq (A), airpol (PM2_5), effect (PMD), unit (NR, RT), geo (IT), time (18 values, 2005 and 2007 to 2023); expected 36 cells, all present.
